title: docs.rs-ready documentation
description: Crate docs: docs.rs metadata (all-features, doc_cfg), missing_docs lint, module docs, README synced with lib.rs, every public item documented with a compiling example where practical.

title: Resource bridge: observable from Leptos Resource/LocalResource
description: from_resource (and SignalExt method form) that emits each resolved value of a Resource/LocalResource, skipping the pending None. Decide on dependency: generic over Get<Value=Option<T>> + Track vs leptos_server. Tests + docs.

title: to_memo: observable -> Memo with PartialEq change suppression
description: Add to_memo / ObservableExt::to_memo building on to_signal so equal consecutive values do not notify dependents. Needs tests and docs.

title: SSR example: Frames and Fetch panels (Effect-wired)
description: Add the animation_frames and from_fetch panels to examples/leptos-ssr with signals created at component level and pipelines wired inside Effect::new; the fetch trigger is a counter signal so the view captures nothing non-Send. Node wasm tests for wire_frames/wire_loader under the hydrate feature; SSR render test asserts the initial markup.

title: CHANGELOG.md ahead of first release
description: Keep a Changelog format; Unreleased section listing every public API since the crate was extracted from Dev916/rxRust.
